items.question: What specific object or mark situated at the forehead is to be regarded as the hundred-thousand count when offered in the act performed for the god-worshipped one?
premises: A mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass is identified here.
That mark is counted as a hundred-thousand in measure.
The act of performance is directed toward the god-worshipped recipient.
items.inference: The hundred-thousand count applies to the forehead-situated mark produced in the act performed for the god-worshipped one.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between kṛtya and the preceding terms remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The mark situated in the mass of forehead syllables, counted as a hundred-thousand, is to be used in the act performed for the god-worshipped one.
